verses.text: And He said to them, “These are My words that I spoke to you while I was still with you: everything written about Me in the Law of Moses and the Prophets and Psalms must be fulfilled.”

verses.text: and said to them, “Thus it is written that the Christ should suffer and rise from the dead on the third day,

verses.text: and that repentance for the forgiveness of sins should be proclaimed in His name to all the nations—beginning from Jerusalem.

verses.text: And behold, I am sending out the promise of My Father upon you; but remain in the city until you are clothed with power from on high.”
